info.title: Spartan API
info.description:
The Spartan API serves the same DLA procurement data as the Spartan app: NSNs and their part numbers, DLA award history, open DIBBS solicitations, no-bid solicitations and CAGE companies. It is a read-only JSON API over HTTPS.

## Getting started

1. **Get an API key.** Sign in to [Spartan](https://data.spartansystems.us), open **Settings → API Keys** and create a key. Keys are available on paid plans. The key is shown once, so copy it somewhere safe.
2. **Send it in the `X-Api-Key` header** on every request.
3. **Make a call:**

```bash
curl -H "X-Api-Key: sk_live_..." \
  "https://api.spartansystems.us/api/v1/search?q=o%20ring&pageSize=5"
```

Every endpoint is a `GET` and returns JSON with camelCase field names. Dates are ISO 8601 (`2026-05-14`), and fields DLA leaves blank are `null`.

## Authentication

Every request needs your key in the `X-Api-Key` header. Keep it server-side: anyone holding it can spend your quota. If a key leaks, revoke or regenerate it under **Settings → API Keys**; the old key stops working at once.

A key works only while your company's subscription is active.

## Rate limits and quota

| Limit | Default |
|---|---|
| Requests per minute, per key | 60 |
| Units per calendar month (UTC), per key | 10,000 |

Each request costs 1 unit. Every request that passes the key check counts, including ones that return `400` or `404`. Need more? Contact us.

Responses to accepted requests carry your remaining allowance (the `X-Usage-*` headers only when the key has a monthly quota):

| Header | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `X-RateLimit-Limit` / `X-RateLimit-Remaining` | Requests allowed this minute, and how many are left |
| `X-RateLimit-Reset` | When the minute window resets (Unix seconds) |
| `X-Usage-Limit` / `X-Usage-Remaining` | Units allowed this month, and how many are left |
| `X-Usage-Reset` | When the month resets (Unix seconds) |

Over either limit you get `429 Too Many Requests`. A per-minute `429` also has a `Retry-After` header in seconds.

## Errors

Key, subscription and limit errors (`401`, `403`, `429`, `503`) and the API's own parameter checks (`400`, e.g. an unknown set-aside code) return `{"message": "..."}`, with a `code` on some. A parameter of the wrong type (`page=abc`) and a `404` return a standard [problem details](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9457) body (`title`, `status`, and for invalid parameters `errors`, keyed by parameter). Branch on the status code, not the body.

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `400` | A parameter is missing or malformed. |
| `401` | The `X-Api-Key` header is missing, or the key is invalid or revoked. |
| `403` | The key's company has no active subscription (`"code": "subscription_required"`). |
| `404` | Nothing matches, e.g. an unknown NIIN or CAGE code. |
| `429` | Rate limit or monthly quota spent. See the headers above. |
| `503` | We couldn't confirm your subscription just then. Retry after a moment. |

## Paging

List endpoints take `page` (from 1) and `pageSize`, and return one page with `totalCount`, `page` and `pageSize`. The rows are in `items`, except search, which calls them `results`. A page past the end comes back empty, so you can page until a response has no rows.

An NSN's record (`GET /api/v1/nsn/{niin}`) doesn't include its awards or solicitations: page through awards with `GET /api/v1/nsn/{niin}/awards`, and find solicitations with `GET /api/v1/solicitations?nsn=` and its 13-digit NSN.

## Identifiers

- **NIIN**: 9 digits, e.g. `012345678`. **NSN**: 13 digits, the 4-digit FSC followed by the NIIN, e.g. `5330-01-234-5678`. Endpoints take either, with or without dashes, and return them without dashes. The one exception is the `nsn` filter on `GET /api/v1/solicitations`, which needs the full 13-digit NSN.
- **CAGE code**: 5 characters, e.g. `1CAY9`.

## How fresh the data is

| Data | Updated |
|---|---|
| DIBBS solicitations | Every 4 hours |
| No-bid solicitations | Daily, 06:00 Pacific |
| Awards, stock, forecasts and other DLA FOIA files | Nightly, as DLA publishes them. DLA's award files run months behind, so the last year of awards is still filling in. |
| Search results | Rebuilt nightly |

## Versioning

Everything here is under `/api/v1`. Within v1 we only add things: new endpoints, new optional parameters and new response fields. Write your client to ignore fields it doesn't know. Removing or renaming a field, or changing what one means, would come as `/api/v2`, with v1 kept running while you move over.

One exception, on 2026-10-19 before any customer had used v1: every endpoint moved to the response shapes documented here (awards became paged; the NSN record, solicitations, no-bid solicitations and companies got their own trimmed models with ISO dates).

get.description: Finds NSNs by item name, NIIN, part number, FSC, CAGE or manufacturer. Send at least one; several narrow the search. Best matches come first: an exact item name, then names that start with the words, then names that contain them.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Words to find in item names, e.g. `o ring` or `bearing ball`, or an NSN or NIIN. Matches whole words in any order; if none match, names that contain the text or look like it.

parameters.name: niin
parameters.description: All or part of a NIIN or NSN; dashes are ignored.

parameters.name: partNumber
parameters.description: All or part of a manufacturer part number.

parameters.name: fsc
parameters.description: Federal Supply Class, e.g. `5330`. Separate several with commas.

parameters.name: cage
parameters.description: A CAGE code that makes the part, e.g. `1CAY9`.

parameters.name: company
parameters.description: All or part of a manufacturer's name.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, from 1.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Results per page, 1 to 100.

results.companyName: JEDNOLITY INDEKS MATERIALOWY - UNIFORM MATERIAL INDEX

get.description: One item's record: FLIS identification and codes, part numbers and manufacturers, approved sources, competition, DLA management data, stock position, lead time, special handling and weapon systems. Awards and solicitations have their own endpoints.

parameters.name: niin
parameters.description: A NIIN or a 13-digit NSN, with or without dashes, e.g. `5330-01-234-5678`.

partNumbers.companyName: U S ARMY TANK AUTOMOTIVE COMMAND AMSTA-IM-MM

get.description: DLA contract awards for the item, one per award, newest first.

parameters.name: niin
parameters.description: A NIIN or a 13-digit NSN, with or without dashes.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, from 1.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Awards per page, 1 to 1,000.

get.description: DIBBS RFQ lines, newest first. Open lines only unless `openOnly=false`.

parameters.name: openOnly
parameters.description: Only lines whose return-by date hasn't passed. Default true.

parameters.name: setAside
parameters.description: Set-aside codes, comma-separated: `Y` small business, `H` HUBZone, `R` SDVOSB, `L` WOSB, `A` 8(a), `E` EDWOSB, `N` none.

parameters.name: nsn
parameters.description: 13-digit NSNs, comma-separated; dashes are ignored.

parameters.name: partNumber
parameters.description: All or part of a part number, comma-separated for several.

parameters.name: cage
parameters.description: CAGE codes that make the item, comma-separated.

parameters.name: itemName
parameters.description: Text the item name contains.

parameters.name: postedFrom
parameters.description: Posted on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Use with `postedTo`.

parameters.name: postedTo
parameters.description: Posted on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Use with `postedFrom`.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, from 1.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Lines per page, 1 to 100.

get.description: Solicitations DLA received no bids on, most recently closed first.

parameters.name: fsc
parameters.description: Federal Supply Class, e.g. `5330`.

parameters.name: nsn
parameters.description: A 9-digit NIIN or a 13-digit NSN; dashes are ignored.

parameters.name: itemName
parameters.description: Text the item name contains.

parameters.name: supplyChain
parameters.description: DLA supply chain, exactly as listed: `Aviation`, `Land`, `Maritime`, `Troop Support (C&E)`, `Troop Support (C&T)`, `Troop Support (Medical)`, `Troop Support (Subsistence)`.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, from 1.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Rows per page, 1 to 100.

get.description: The company behind a CAGE code: name, location, CAGE status and type.

parameters.name: cageCode
parameters.description: A 5-character CAGE code, e.g. `1CAY9`.

poNumber.description: DLA purchase order number; with `poLine` it identifies the award.

partNumbers.description: Every part number DLA listed the award under.

standardUnitPrice.description: DLA's standard unit price for the item at the time.

awardeeCount.description: Distinct companies that have won the item.

supplyChain.description: DLA supply chain: `Aviation`, `Land`, `Maritime`, or a `Troop Support (...)` chain.

closedDate.description: When the solicitation closed with no bids.

nsn.description: 13 digits: FSC then NIIN. Null, with `fsc`, when DLA has no FSC for the item.

inFlis.description: False when the NIIN is known only from awards or solicitations, not from FLIS; the FLIS fields are then empty.

cancelledNiins.description: NIINs DLA cancelled in favor of this one.

partNumbers.description: Every part number cross-referenced to the item, with its manufacturer.

approvedSources.description: DLA's approved sources for the item.

management.description: DLA management records (unit price, unit of issue, source of supply), newest first.

totalPages.description: Pages you can request. Paging stops at 10,000 results; narrow the search to reach the rest.

matchSet.description: `words` when results contain the words of `q`; `close` when nothing did and these are similar names instead.

didYouMean.description: A corrected `q` that has results, offered when the one sent found few or no word matches.

partNumber.description: One of the item's part numbers; GET /api/v1/nsn/{niin} lists them all.

cageCode.description: The CAGE code of that part number.

latestUnitPrice.description: Unit price on the newest record in DLA's price-reasonableness file for this item, if any.

nsn.description: As DIBBS lists it: usually a 13-digit NSN, sometimes a bare NIIN or a CAGE code with a part number.

niin.description: The NIIN read from `nsn`, when it holds one.

postedDate.description: The date DIBBS posted the RFQ.

returnBy.description: Quotes are due by this date.

estimatedUnitPrice.description: The newest DLA award price for the NIIN, as an estimate; null when there is none.

deliveryDays.description: Required delivery, in days after award.

setAside.description: DIBBS set-aside code: `Y` small business, `H` HUBZone, `R` SDVOSB, `L` WOSB, `A` 8(a), `N` none.

solicitationType.description: `F` fast auto evaluation, `I` automated IDC, `P` auto evaluation.

higherLevelQuality.description: Higher-level quality standard required: `N` none, `6` SAE AS9003 (or ISO 9001 tailored to it), `7` ISO 9001:2015, `8` SAE AS9100.
